meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, Toutiao, or Tencent Cloud Developer Community drafts through a browser. Use for product introductions, encyclopedia articles or entry drafts, and writing tailored to platforms or search targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 直接变成公众号排版文章、配图和草稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常写公众号或平台文章,想省掉排版、配图和发布的手工活。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown into formatted WeChat articles, images, and drafts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write WeChat or blog articles and want to skip manual formatting.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 md2wechat 命令：把 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML、预览并检查元数据，还能生成配图、创建草稿、给标题建议、按创作者风格写作和去除 AI 写作痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求把文章转成公众号 HTML、生成配图或创建草稿，或要处理知乎、CSDN 等平台的未发布草稿时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 article.md 转成公众号 HTML，先给我预览
say.note: 会先跑 inspect 和 preview，不发布

say.text: 给这篇文章生成 3 个公众号标题建议
say.note: 只输出标题提示请求，不写回文件

say.text: 按我的创作者风格改写这篇，去掉 AI 痕迹
say.note: 走 write 或 humanize 路径

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives the md2wechat CLI: convert Markdown into WeChat article HTML, preview it, inspect metadata, generate images, create drafts, suggest titles, write in creator styles, and remove AI traces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to convert or format an article into WeChat HTML, generate images, or create drafts, or to prepare unpublished drafts for Zhihu, CSDN and similar platforms.

say_en.text: Convert article.md into WeChat HTML and show me a preview first
say_en.note: Runs inspect and preview only; nothing is published

say_en.text: Suggest 3 WeChat titles for this article
say_en.note: Emits a title prompt request only; no write-back

say_en.text: Rewrite this in my creator style and remove AI traces
say_en.note: Uses the write or humanize path
